title: Recharging Assessed Damage Against a Car Rental
content:
Where the rental desk has assessed damage on a rental booked under the Car Rental Rate Classes, that damage
is recharged to the renter against the supplier's own reference for the incident. The recharge stands on
the rental as a charge to the renter and not as a payment by them, and the rental's net charged total rises
by the amount recharged.

## The handling action

The desk does this for the renter. The tool `post_damage_recharge_2d59c35f` is unlocked and then called.
One call books a single damage line on that rental for the amount given, quoting the supplier's own
reference for the incident it settles, so the renter can see the damage standing against the rental with
the reference it was assessed under. One damage line is booked for each review reference.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `drive_rental_id` | the internal reference number of the car rental the damage is recharged against | an identifier, read from the rental record returned by the car rental lookup |
| `customer_id` | the traveller reference number of the renter being recharged | an identifier, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup |
| `drive_review_id` | the reference number of the rental damage review the desk decided for this incident | an identifier, read from the rental damage review lookup |
| `damage_reference` | the supplier's own reference for the damaged vehicle as it is recorded on that rental damage review | verbatim: copied character for character with the original wording, digits and punctuation kept, and nothing translated, tidied, shortened or added |
| `damage_recharge_usd` | the amount recharged | a US dollar amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent at the moment it is booked, given as a positive figure and never left empty |

None of the five parameters carries a fixed set of permitted values; each is the value the record or the
figure gives.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the reference number of the new damage line, the rental it was booked
against, the amount recharged in US dollars to 2 decimal places and the supplier reference it settles. A
sentence of that shape means the line is on the rental's ledger; any other reply means nothing was
recharged.
